Bounty Overnight Oats Recipe
breakfast recipes | overnight oats | meal prep friendly | vegan 

Nutrition: 
C: 42 | F: 26 | P: 14
Calories: 
456 per serve ( using chocolate ) 
345 per serve ( using cocoa paste ) 
Serves 1

Ingredients
35 grams oats
1 tbsp chia seeds
60 ml coconut milk + 60 ml milk of choice 
40 grams coconut yogurt OR greek yogurt
pinch of salt
1 tbsp sweetener ( honey/ maple syrup/sugar )

topping
2-3 chocolate pieces + 1 tbsp milk
OR 1 tbsp cocoa powder + water + 1 tsp monkfruit to create a paste 
dessicated coconut 

Method 
combine all the ingredients for the oats in a bowl and stir together 
store it overnight in the fridge 
the next morning, place in a cup and top with the chocolate to create a shell
enjoy :)
